description: hermes-node operator repo registry. Authoritative list of repos the operator can act on. Human-edited, git-tracked. Paths may use ~ for the service user's home. Absence of a path is OK — the registry reports `present=false` and the operator refuses mutation for that entry, which is the fail-closed behavior we want. Future repos should be added to `future_slots` until they have a real path, then promoted into `repos`.

repos.name: ixion
repos.description: Ixion robotics VP core repo. Local dev target; VPS presence is not required and absence is the expected state there.

future_slots.name: treasuryos
future_slots.description: TreasuryOS — future repo, not yet live anywhere. Placeholder slot so registry shape is stable when the repo materializes.
future_slots.notes: Do not fabricate a path. Promote into `repos` once the repo exists on disk and is git-tracked.
